items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I'm talking about Wynton and the other young kid with Blakey... They play something out of sight, man!

ctx.x: can't really say that I like what they're doing. Although what they're doing is amazing. Like, they play... I'm talking about Wynton and the other young kid with Blakey... They play something out of sight, man! I mean, what they're doing is really an amazing thing to see. But I mean, the sound of it don't enhance me like the sound of Fats and Miles and them did in the earlier days. So I can't say it's bad, but I can't say it's good either.
Well, how do you feel about Coltrane's influence on the music?
